analyst_view.overall: Fran Escribá's Real Valladolid (12th, 19 points) host Real Sociedad B (19th, 13 points, in the drop zone) at Zorrilla on Saturday night; the numbers make Valladolid favourites with about 2.5 goals. The Sanse lost 0-3 at home to Cádiz on 21 November and finished with nine men: Alex Marchal and Gorka Carrera, two of their front three, are banned (the numbers count both), and Iñaki Rupérez is also out (the RFEF list has him banned for yellow cards, FotMob lists a muscle injury), which the numbers do not count. Valladolid drew 1-1 at Celta Fortuna with a young side; striker Juanmi Latasa was held back there, Diario de Valladolid said Escribá was 'almost convinced' he would be ready for this game and a COPE headline on 24 November says the club 'recovers' him (I could not open the article), while the numbers still take him out (FotMob lists him until early December), so I add a little to Valladolid's goals. Trilli is out for about a month and Guille Bueno is only easing back after a long injury. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals, 1.5 for Valladolid, after taking 7.6% off their goals for Latasa and 6.8% off the Sanse's for Carrera's ban. Diario de Valladolid said Latasa would be ready and a COPE headline says he is back, so that deduction looks too large; he may start on the bench after injury, so I give back only part of it, +4%, about 2.6. The Sanse's other absences (Marchal, Rupérez) and their 0-3 home defeat do not suggest they will score more.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.9 corners, 6.0 for Valladolid, already raised for both sides' busy recent corner counts (40 for Valladolid in six). Escribá calls his side offensive and the Sanse play out from the back as a reserve side does; nothing on lineups or tactics points either way, so I stay at about 10.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.0 cards, already high for Segunda and raised a little for the Sanse's recent bookings, including the two second-yellow red cards against Cádiz and Rupérez's fifth yellow. A relegation-threatened young side away from home can pick up cards, but the numbers already see their record, and no referee is named yet, so I stay at about 6.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.7 shots, already lifted for the Sanse's busy recent shooting against Valladolid's open defence (+13.9%). Without Marchal and Carrera the Sanse front line is weaker, but the numbers count both bans, and Latasa's return changes who shoots more than how often; I stay at about 29.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target, already raised for Valladolid's sharp recent shooting (40 on target in six, +8.0%). With Latasa, their first-choice striker, reported fit after being left out at Celta Fortuna, I add a little, +3%, about 9.5.
